inputs.text: Don’t be fooled by the stable petrol and diesel prices. The conflict involving the US, Israel, and Iran is being used to make higher oil costs look inevitable, while the government’s excise-duty cuts create the appearance of protecting people and quietly squeeze public revenue instead. With India dependent on crude imports, ordinary consumers are left exposed to whatever comes next, while those managing the crisis control the story as much as the prices. The long-term consequences are still being kept conveniently vague.
